## 1. Executive Summary

This report documents the reproducible cohort validation analysis using synthetic datasets.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(survival)
```

## 2. Cohort Data Distribution

```{r load-data}
# Synthetic data loading
cohort <- read.csv("../../data/synthetic/synthetic_cohort.csv")
summary(cohort)
```

## 3. Survival Analysis

```{r km-plot}
fit <- survfit(Surv(followup_days, event_occurred) ~ treatment_arm, data = cohort)
plot(fit, col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1:2,
     xlab = "Follow-up Days", ylab = "Survival Probability",
     main = "Kaplan-Meier Survival Curves")
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Active", "Control"), col = c("blue", "red"), lty = 1:2)
```
